status: geometric protection candidate; not a print or functional qualification

closed_shell_bounds_mm.scope: First bound is for present coplanar axes. Second/third bound use three equal non-overlapping disks; the fourth union and fluid/electrical geometry add requirements. No claim about all staggered connector architectures.

removable_cap_bound_mm.scope: A removable cap covers bare stubs only; attachment to the Ø34 boot and protection during coupling need separate design.

lateral_protection.method: Native cage tessellation projected to X/Z; convex-hull support compared with exact circular tube support. Broad planar lateral obstacles only.
lateral_protection.scope: Nominal rigid-body geometry. Open corner slots admit narrow protrusions. This does not rate impact, stiffness, fatigue, print variation or permanent tube alignment.

sharp_cusp_upper_bound_lateral_protectio.method: Native cage tessellation projected to X/Z; convex-hull support compared with exact circular tube support. Broad planar lateral obstacles only.
sharp_cusp_upper_bound_lateral_protectio.scope: Nominal rigid-body geometry. Open corner slots admit narrow protrusions. This does not rate impact, stiffness, fatigue, print variation or permanent tube alignment.

cup_mm.scope: Roof angle, snap leaf thickness and deflection gap inherited from the socket. Socket/receiver widened 2.4 mm in total to preserve 1.55 mm cup-to-slit stock. Top bridge and fence/support orientation are not print qualified.

confined_space_mm.scope: Rigid axial approach only; excludes bundle bend, hands and installation obstructions.

limits: The open cage shields broad plane contact; narrow objects can enter its corner windows and insertion face.
Guard and receiver remain exploratory. The saved trial is the unguarded boot; no new print has been sliced or launched.
The 4 mm union envelope and release geometry remain provisional; its clearance cuts require the selected part's actual envelope.
The longer guard adds 2 mm approach stroke; it does not shorten the 98 mm boot or establish acceptable confined-space UX.
Socket/frame outer width is 2.4 mm greater than the saved baseline; the matching coupon is modeled but integration and printing are unqualified.
The rounded 1 mm outer tip feature has only about 0.52 mm nominal broad-plane lead; actual extrusion, stiffness and handling must establish whether that margin is useful.
union_sweep_argument: Every cage sector is cut outside the maximum full-ring cylinders along its complete positive-Y length; axial translation and independent union float therefore cannot bring a ring into the cage at these fixed axes. This conservative sweep also excludes thicker collets only if the actual selected parts remain within the ring envelope.
